scope: Supplemental families added in v3 beyond frozen v2: ten licensed, verified documents (SKAT India Mark II and III, PRACTICA rope pump, NAVEDTRA 14075/14259/14057, Voron 2.4R2, LulzBot TAZ 6, FarmBot Genesis v1.8, PrintNC v4).

owner_decisions.usbr_excluded: USBR FIST 2-12 (2024) and FIST 4-1A were verified but excluded: they are US federal works yet carry an express "internal use only" distribution statement. The recorded v1 exclusion stands; a thesis artifact should not rest on treating a stated distribution limitation as void.
owner_decisions.voron_gpl: Repo-level GPL-3.0 for the repository that ships the assembly manual; recorded as share_alike rather than permissive.
owner_decisions.lulzbot_ambiguity: The manual states CC BY and CC BY-SA in different places; the conservative BY-SA reading is recorded as share_alike.
owner_decisions.html_bundles: Committed documentation text bundles count as documents, matching how OSE/RepRap/LowRider HTML sources were already counted.

counts.note: 48 families against an approximately-50 target; the two-document gap is the two excluded USBR manuals. Do not describe this as 50 or as Track A complete.

documents.title: Rope Pump - Technical Training Handbook on Rope Pump Production, Installation and Maintenance, PRACTICA Foundation, 3rd edition August 2011; 93 pp, complete
documents.attribution: PRACTICA Foundation, reference to the source required
documents.licence_quote: This manual is free of charge. Any parts of this instruction manual, including the illustrations and technical drawings may be copied to meet local needs, without permission from the author or publisher, provided the parts are distributed free, not for profit and reference to the source is made. For any reproduction with commercial ends, written permission must be obtained in advance from the PRACTICA Foundation.
documents.licence_caveat: Non-commercial clause: redistribution for profit needs written permission. Text and drawings are in scope; credited photos/illustrations (Ron Offerman/Tekenteam, PRACTICA) should be treated as covered only if the same terms are honoured.

documents.title: Engineman 1 & C, NAVEDTRA 14075, April 1987, NETPDTC; 320 pp, complete with errata and assignment booklet
documents.attribution: U.S. federal work (17 U.S.C. §105); NAVEDTRA 14075, Distribution Statement A per the report; credited third-party figures excluded
documents.licence_quote: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
documents.licence_caveat: Distribution statement is not itself a copyright grant; corpus treats Navy TRAMANs as 17 U.S.C. 105 works. This edition carries a CREDITS page: 'Permission to reproduce illustrations and other materials in this publication should be obtained from the source' (Bacharach Industrial Instrument Co. figures) - exclude credited figures from extraction.

documents.licence_caveat: No CREDITS/copyright page found in extracted text; distribution statement plus 17 U.S.C. 105 is the basis, consistent with the other Navy manuals in v1/v2.

documents.title: Voron 2.4R2 Assembly Manual, 263 A4 pages, PDF created 2023-07-05, from VoronDesign/Voron-2 branch Voron2.4, path Manual/Assembly_Manual_2.4r2.pdf
documents.attribution: Voron Design; repository licensed GNU GPL v3.0
documents.licence_quote: GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE / Version 3, 29 June 2007 (repository LICENSE; GitHub licence metadata: gpl-3.0).
documents.licence_caveat: The GPL-3.0 licence is declared at repository level; the assembly PDF sits inside that repository (Manual/) and no separate notice appears in the PDF. GPL is a software licence applied here to documentation - record identifier as GPL-3.0 and share_alike true; flag if the corpus requires an OSI-document licence instead.

documents.title: LulzBot TAZ 6 User Manual, Aleph Objects Inc., 2016, ISBN 978-0-9893784-8-2, 90 pp, complete
documents.licence_quote: Permission is granted to copy, distribute and/or modify this document under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Public License (CC BY-SA 4.0).
documents.licence_caveat: The printed notice names 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International' but parenthesises 'CC BY-SA 4.0' - internally inconsistent. Either interpretation permits redistribution; share_alike should be recorded true until the ambiguity is resolved (CC BY 4.0 would be share_alike false).

documents.title: FarmBot Genesis v1.8 documentation: 21 pages of the assembly section (intro, preparation, overview, safety, raised beds, tracks, gantry, cross-slide and Z-axis, toolbays, tools, electronics, final steps) plus 6 maintenance pages; mirrored as a text bundle
documents.attribution: not required (CC0); courtesy credit FarmBot Inc.
documents.licence_quote: FarmBot documentation is licensed under the CC0 Public Domain Dedication. In short, this means you are free to use the documentation content (text, images, tables, videos, etc) as you please, without attribution or needing to request permission.
documents.licence_caveat: The same licensing page carves out 'non-functional works' (marketing material, brand assets, photos, videos) under CC BY-NC 4.0; only the documentation text is CC0. Bundle is text-only and excludes images/videos; note that per-page navigation text is repeated and the corpus extractor will need the usual procedural-paragraph filter.

documents.title: PrintNC Wiki v4 - Assembly (steps 1-11, drilling/tapping HGR20 linear rails) plus Painting page; site content licence declared cc0
documents.attribution: not required if CC0; PrintNC project credit courtesy
documents.licence_quote: Wiki page source: "contentLicense":"cc0". Repository LICENSE.md: "creative commons / Attribution 4.0 International".
documents.licence_caveat: Licence evidence is the wiki's site-wide content-licence setting plus the repo CC BY 4.0 file; no per-page footer statement. If a visible per-page licence statement is required, the repo CC BY 4.0 file is the fallback (attribution required).
